title: apt_repository
description: An apt source in deb822 form with its own signing key (D-260). Key: name. The agent writes /etc/apt/sources.list.d/plumb-<name>.sources and the key to /etc/apt/keyrings/plumb-<name>.asc; the sources file names that key in Signed-By. Plumb writes no other option: Trusted and trusted.gpg.d cannot be expressed. Apply runs apt-get update. Risk: create, change and delete are reversible (installed packages stay). Kinds: vm, lxc.

name.description: Short name; part of both file names.

uris.description: Repository URIs (URIs:). Required when state is present.

suites.description: Suites: lines, for example trixie. A suite that ends in / is an exact path and then components must be empty (the agent checks it). Required when state is present.

components.description: Components: line, for example stable. Must not be empty unless a suite ends in /.

architectures.description: Architectures: line. Empty means all of the guest.

key.pattern: ^-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----\r?\n[\s\S]*\r?\n-----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----\s*$
key.description: The ASCII-armored public signing key, inline: it is never downloaded at apply. Exactly one public key block; a private key block is refused here, before it reaches a revision. Required when state is present.

not.pattern: PRIVATE KEY BLOCK|-----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----[\s\S]*-----BEGIN
